class TestBenjaminiHochberg(unittest.TestCase):

        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [])
        self.assertEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.0)

    def test_empty_p_values_tuple(self):
        res = fdr_control.benjamini_hochberg((), alpha=0.05)
        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [])
        self.assertEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.0)

    def test_single_p_value_rejected(self):
        res = fdr_control.benjamini_hochberg([0.03], alpha=0.05)
        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [True])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.05)

        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [False])
        self.assertEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.0)

        res = fdr_control.benjamini_hochberg([0.05], alpha=0.05)
        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [True])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.05)

    def test_no_k_satisfies_inequality(self):
        res = fdr_control.benjamini_hochberg([0.2, 0.3, 0.4], alpha=0.05)
        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [False, False, False])
        self.assertEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.0)

        res = fdr_control.benjamini_hochberg([0.01, 0.02, 0.03], alpha=0.05)
        self.assertEqual(res.rejected, [True, True, True])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(res.critical_threshold, 0.05)

        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("foo---bar"), "foo-bar")

        total_tokens=100,
        tool_errors=0,
        rie_accepted=True,
    ):
        if hasattr(pareto_judge, "HarnessCandidate"):
            try:
                return pareto_judge.HarnessCandidate(
                    candidate_id=candidate_id,
                    wall_clock_s=wall_clock_s,
                    total_tokens=total_tokens,
                    tool_errors=tool_errors,
                    rie_accepted=rie_accepted,
                )
            except TypeError:
                try:
                    return pareto_judge.HarnessCandidate(
                        candidate_id,
                        wall_clock_s,
                        total_tokens,
                        tool_errors,
                        rie_accepted,
                    )
                except TypeError:
                    try:
                        return pareto_judge.HarnessCandidate(
                            wall_clock_s,
                            total_tokens,
                            tool_errors,
                            candidate_id,
                            rie_accepted,
                        )
                    except TypeError:
                        pass

        class _Candidate:
            def __init__(self, cid, wc, tt, te, ra):
                self.candidate_id = cid
                self.wall_clock_s = wc
                self.total_tokens = tt
                self.tool_errors = te
                self.rie_accepted = ra

        return _Candidate(
            candidate_id, wall_clock_s, total_tokens, tool_errors, rie_accepted
        )

    def test_dominates_strictly_better_all_metrics(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=0)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=200, tool_errors=1)
        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(b, a))

    def test_dominates_strictly_better_one_metric_equal_others(self):
        base = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=200, tool_errors=2)
        better_time = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=200, tool_errors=2)
        better_tokens = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=2)
        better_errors = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=200, tool_errors=1)

        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(better_time, base))
        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(better_tokens, base))
        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(better_errors, base))

    def test_dominates_strictly_better_two_metrics_equal_one(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=2)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=200, tool_errors=2)
        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(b, a))

    def test_dominates_equal_all_metrics(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=1)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=1)
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(b, a))

    def test_dominates_worse_on_one_metric(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=3.0, total_tokens=50, tool_errors=0)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=2.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=1)
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(b, a))

    def test_dominates_worse_on_all_metrics(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=3.0, total_tokens=300, tool_errors=3)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=1.0, total_tokens=100, tool_errors=0)
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))

    def test_dominates_edge_zeros(self):
        a = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=0.0, total_tokens=0, tool_errors=0)
        b = self._candidate(wall_clock_s=0.0, total_tokens=0, tool_errors=1)
        self.assertTrue(pareto_judge.dominates(a, b))
        self.assertFalse(pareto_judge.dominates(b, a))

        self.assertEqual(pareto_judge.select_pareto_frontier([]), [])

    def test_select_pareto_frontier_single_rejected(self):

        c_rej = self._candidate(

            wall_clock_s=0.5,
            total_tokens=10,
            tool_errors=0,
            rie_accepted=False,
        )
        c_acc = self._candidate(

        try:

        except TypeError:
            return SampleRecord(sample_id, group_id)

        records = [self._record(1, "A"), self._record(2, "B")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=1)

    def test_value_error_when_n_splits_is_zero(self):
        records = [self._record(1, "A"), self._record(2, "B")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=0)

    def test_value_error_when_n_splits_is_negative(self):
        records = [self._record(1, "A"), self._record(2, "B")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=-1)

    def test_value_error_when_records_empty(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits([], n_splits=2)

    def test_value_error_when_single_group_with_n_splits_two(self):
        records = [self._record(1, "A"), self._record(2, "A")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=2)

    def test_value_error_when_fewer_unique_groups_than_n_splits(self):
        records = [
            self._record(1, "A"),
            self._record(2, "B"),
            self._record(3, "A"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=3)

    def test_minimal_valid_two_splits_two_groups(self):
        records = [self._record(1, "A"), self._record(2, "B")]
        result = group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=2)
        expected = [
            ([2], [1]),
            ([1], [2]),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)

    def test_unique_groups_equal_to_n_splits(self):
        records = [
            self._record(10, "X"),
            self._record(20, "Y"),
            self._record(30, "Z"),
        ]
        result = group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=3)
        expected = [
            ([20, 30], [10]),
            ([10, 30], [20]),
            ([10, 20], [30]),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)

        records = [
            self._record(1, "B"),
            self._record(2, "A"),
            self._record(3, "B"),
            self._record(4, "C"),
            self._record(5, "A"),
        ]
        result = group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=2)

            self._record(2, "g1"),
            self._record(3, "g2"),
            self._record(4, "g3"),
            self._record(5, "g4"),
            self._record(6, "g0"),
            self._record(7, "g2"),

        result = group_splitter.group_kfold_splits(records, n_splits=3)

            ([1, 3, 4, 6, 7], [2, 5]),

        ]
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)

        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("abc123xyz"), "abc123xyz")

    def test_single_character_alnum_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("A"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("9"), "9")

    def test_single_non_alnum_becomes_hyphen(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("hello world"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("foo_bar"), "foo-bar")

    def test_run_of_non_alnum_becomes_single_hyphen(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("hello   world"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("foo---bar"), "foo-bar")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("foo!@#bar"), "foo-bar")

    def test_non_ascii_characters_become_hyphen(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("aé1"), "a-1")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("hello—world"), "hello-world")

    def test_no_leading_or_trailing_hyphen(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("-hello-"), "hello")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("---hello---world---"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("   hello world   "), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugs.slugify("!hello!"), "hello")

    def test_value_error_empty_string(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("")

    def test_value_error_whitespace_only(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("   \t\n ")

    def test_value_error_punctuation_and_symbols_only(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("---")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("!@#$%^&*()_+=-[]{};:'\",.<>?/\\|`~")

    def test_value_error_non_ascii_only(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("éèçñ")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify("你好世界")

    def test_value_error_mixed_non_alnum_and_non_ascii_only(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            slugs.slugify(" - ! é ★ ? - ")

    unittest.main()
